mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ATT_CLOSE WHERE EMP_ID = #{employeeId} AND TRUNC(WORK_DATE, 'MM') = TRUNC(#{workDate}, 'MM') AND STATUS = 'MONTH_CLOSED'
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TB_ATT_DAILY T USING (SELECT #{employeeId} EMP_ID, #{workDate} WORK_DATE FROM DUAL) S ON (T.EMP_ID = S.EMP_ID AND T.WORK_DATE = S.WORK_DATE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.REFLECTED_MINUTES = #{reflectedMinutes} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (EMP_ID, WORK_DATE, REFLECTED_MINUTES) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{workDate}, #{reflectedMinutes})
